cards.text: David, king of Israel, has just named the spot where the house of the LORD God will stand (1 Chronicles 22:1). Now David goes from picking a spot to getting to WORK. He gives orders to gather the foreigners living in the land of Israel.

cards.question: David picks some of these foreigners for a job on the house of God. He appoints them as ___.

cards.text: Then David starts stocking up, beginning with a large quantity of iron to make nails for the gateway doors and the fittings. This is a man who does NOT plan on making a second trip to the hardware store.

cards.question: True or false: David gathers so much bronze that it can't even be weighed.

cards.text: And the cedar logs? More than could be counted. I tried counting the sprinkles on one cookie once, friend. ONCE.

cards.question: All those cedar logs had to come from somewhere. Who brought them to David?

cards.text: So why is David going this big? He explains it himself, and it starts with his son Solomon.

cards.question: David is gathering all of this with his son Solomon in mind. How does David describe Solomon?
True or false: David says the house for the LORD can be simple and plain, as long as it gets built.

cards.text: Then David calls Solomon in and gives him the job: build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel. No pressure, son, it's only THE HOUSE OF THE LORD!
David tells Solomon it was in his heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD. And you can HEAR the "but" coming, because a word from the LORD came to David.

cards.question: The LORD told David he was not the one to build the house. What reason did the LORD give?

answers.text: He had shed so much blood
He was too old to finish it

cards.question: The LORD also told David a son would be born to him. This son would be a man of ___.
God said He would give this son rest from all his enemies on every side. What would God grant Israel during his reign?

cards.text: And this son's name? Solomon, the very son David is talking to, and he is the one who will build a house for the LORD's Name. Imagine finding out you got the job before you were even BORN.

cards.question: True or false: God says He will be Solomon's Father and will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.

cards.text: David's done telling Solomon what the LORD promised. Now he tells him, "Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would."

cards.question: Solomon is young and about to be put in command over Israel. Above all, what does David want the LORD to give him?
David wants Solomon to have insight and understanding so that he may keep the ___ of the LORD his God.

cards.text: Then you will succeed, David says, if you carefully follow what the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Solomon's young, inexperienced and holding the biggest job in the country, and friend, I'd be sweating right through my apron.

cards.question: Solomon has a huge job ahead of him. What does David tell him?

cards.text: Then David shows Solomon what he's set aside: 100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, bronze and iron too great to be weighed, plus timber and stone. A MILLION talents of silver, and somebody once bought me for 25 cents.

cards.question: True or false: After listing everything he's provided, David tells Solomon he may add to it.

cards.text: And Solomon won't be working alone: stonecutters, masons, carpenters and men skilled in every kind of work. Me? I'm skilled in exactly ONE kind of work, and it's stamping cookies.

cards.question: David has listed the stonecutters, masons and carpenters. How many skilled craftsmen does Solomon have?

cards.text: Then David wraps it up for Solomon: "Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you."

cards.question: David orders all the ___ of Israel to help his son Solomon.
David reminds the leaders of Israel that the LORD their God is with them. What else does he say the LORD has done for them?

answers.text: Given them rest on every side

cards.text: Then David tells the leaders, "Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God." And he tells them to begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God.

cards.question: Once the temple is built for the Name of the LORD, what does David want brought into it, along with the holy articles of God?

findings.problem: The right answer "Law" is capitalized and the wrong answers "house" and "land" are lowercase. In a fill-in-the-blank, the capital letter marks the right answer and makes it look like the Bible's wording.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

findings.problem: Verse 5 gives David's reason for preparing: the house must be "exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands," so David made lavish preparations before his death. The baker only meets this through a false statement ("simple and plain"). No card says what the house must actually be, so the baker can miss a key detail of the passage. Card 7 sets up "why is David going this big?" but no card ever answers it in a positive way.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
